facts.fact: The Registre National des Entreprises, in service since 5 February 2019, completed full digitisation in July 2026, so filing, registration and updates can all be done remotely on its digital platform, says its director general Adel Chaouari.
The Registre National des Entreprises also manages the register of beneficial owners, set up for anti-money-laundering and counter-terrorist-financing purposes, according to the article.
